properties.handles: AllocationExceededException, EmployeeNotFoundException, ProjectNotFoundException, InvalidProjectStatusException, DuplicateResourceException, MethodArgumentNotValidException

properties.trigger: allocate into COMPLETED project or invalid status transition

properties.rule: Sum of overlapping allocations per employee <= 100%

Allocation period must be within project duration

properties.scope: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on allocation rows per employee
properties.purpose: Prevent race condition on total allocation > 100%

properties.sql: SELECT e.employee_id, e.full_name, COALESCE(SUM(a.allocation_percent), 0) AS total_allocation FROM employee e LEFT JOIN allocation a ... GROUP BY ...
